description: The Zusters van Orthenpoort, down-town courtyard in ‘s-Hertogenbosch in The Netherlands. The people who come here live here. Only a lost tourist comes in this area. A postman brings a packet. A single man walking and one woman on a bike. The carillon of the Saint Johns dome (sint jan) is close here. The wind is here some moments. It’s calm here.
